label: Deal role cards
hint: One role card to each citizen, and the information sheets to the elite. Allowed until the meeting starts.

label: Choose the co-Chairs
hint: Two citizens picked at random. Potamosia only.

label: Start the meeting
hint: Keeps who holds which card and its interest, and closes the dealing.

label: Open the public assembly
hint: A king opens the council's meeting to the townspeople to question and heckle. Hudrosia only.

label: Call the vote
hint: Calls a vote on the written proposal you moved onto the floor and hands out the ballots. A co-Chair or king, or the facilitator.

label: Count the vote
hint: Anyone without a hand up counts against. A co-Chair or king, or the facilitator.

label: Add a proposal
hint: A blank proposal note. Click it to select it, then click it again to write the proposal.

label: Join the queue
hint: Put your name on the speaking queue.

label: Next speaker
hint: Take the first speaker off the queue. A co-Chair or king, or the facilitator.

label: Reset
hint: Put the city's table back as it was when the activity began.
confirm: Are you sure? This takes every card off the city's table and lays it out again, as it was when the activity began.

label: Collect all cards
hint: Every role card and sheet back into the box.
